fields.name: person
fields.type: string (Person.id of the owner; '' when not one of the sample people)

fields.name: plan
fields.type: PlanKey from lib/pro-data (starter|studio|pack|... as PLANS keys)

fields.name: used
fields.type: number (wishes made this month or from the pack)

fields.name: invoices
fields.type: BizInvoice[] {no,date,what,amount:number naira,vat:number naira,state:'paid'|'due'|'failed'} newest first; the UI reads invoices[0] as the last invoice

fields.name: allowance
fields.type: number (derived: plan wishes + rolled for monthly plans)

reads.pagination: none; logins, invoices and record are embedded lists
reads.note: Plan facts shown (Price, wishes per month, logins allowed, 'More space' copy) come from lib/pro-data.ts PLANS/VAULT/VAULT_MORE, not from the seam. Owner links to /admin/people/:person when person is non-empty.

authContext.note: Roles from lib/admin/d-fixtures.ts access table (marked 'Default (lead), owner may override'). Staff sign-in is a six-digit code (admin-api.ts verifyCode accepts any six digits in sample), kept in memory only.

notes: read-only; no invoice actions (no retry or refund of a failed invoice)

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: !b and no error: back link, Head and Loading
uiStatesHandled.reachable: no today (the seam is an async function over in-memory data and resolves in a microtask); yes once a real request exists
yes for an unknown id (not_found 'That is not here.')

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: stat tiles, plan facts, logins, record, invoices
none coded: lists render empty; Timeline handles its own empty
uiStatesHandled.reachable: no (every sample business has at least one of each)

uiStatesHandled.state: last charge failed vs good standing
